facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during shift handover while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 May 2014 a hazard report was recorded on P-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
